justification: Standard: small code change (a new 'key' kind in gate_rules_land.py) plus data. 31 City of Sydney schedule rules, previously withheld for everyone, are now keyed to outlines already in dcp_precinct_boundaries (5.2 Green Square 16, 5.1 Central Sydney 13, 5.11 Oxford Street 2), so only houses inside see them. Applied live with owner go and a row backup.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Prints to-change greater than 0 after the apply.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the apply it printed to-change=31; after, 0. DQ-148 is 0.

break_it.scenario: Locality 5.2 is not the same area as the Green Square Urban Renewal Area.
break_it.what_happens: Houses in 5.2 outside the renewal area, or the reverse, see or miss Schedule 10 rules.
break_it.how: Accepted; the area size matches the public figure closely. Undo is the row backup.
break_it.repro: Compare dcp_precinct_boundaries 5.2 with the City's Green Square development area layer.

break_it.scenario: A publish re-sets the rows to unkeyed.
break_it.what_happens: Rules reach all houses or none again.
break_it.how: The step runs after every publish and matches by text fingerprint.

break_it.scenario: A row already keyed, heritage-marked or in a condition layer is overwritten.
break_it.how: The key kind skips those rows; covered by a unit test.

post_merge.manual_verify: A Darlington house no longer shows Green Square rules; not checked in a browser.

functions.name: apply_land_limits
functions.input: A database cursor, an optional council slug, an apply flag, an optional set of rule names
functions.output: A list of (id, column, before, after, rule) changes; the key kind emits a precinct id change and, when needed, a layer change
functions.if_none: A row with no text, an unlisted fingerprint, a precinct key, a heritage marker or a condition layer is left alone

queries.purpose: Select current rows of one council and chapter so listed ones can be limited
queries.where_clause: is_current AND source_council AND source_chapter_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
queries.if_zero: No rows change; the step prints to-change=0

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_precinct_boundaries already holds City of Sydney outlines 5.1, 5.2 and 5.11 from the City's open data; Sydney is not a nearest-fallback LGA, so houses outside get no precinct.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed Schedule 10's 'Green Square Urban Renewal Area (Green Square)' is the 5.2 Green Square locality; the area (about 276.6 ha) is close to the public figure for the renewal area, but the boundary was not confirmed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends gate_rules_land with kind 'key'; no new script.
